deposits.title: ROTATIONAL POWER

exercises.name: Rotational Medicine-Ball Slam
exercises.cue: Snap from hips; reset completely. Use only a ball rated for slams.
exercises.prescription: 3 crisp rotational slams/side with controlled retrieval. Light enough to stay fast.
exercises.home: 3 crisp rotational slams/side with controlled retrieval. Light enough to stay fast.
exercises.away: Use the listed unloaded regression or comparable available equipment

deposits.effort: Rest 90 sec. End early if speed drops.

deposits.title: DB SPLIT SQUAT

exercises.name: Front-Foot-Elevated Dumbbell Split Squat
exercises.cue: Use a stable low step; front knee tracks over toes; control the descent.
exercises.prescription: 6–8/side; use floor-level stance if no stable riser. Leave 2–3 good reps.
exercises.home: 6–8/side; use floor-level stance if no stable riser. Leave 2–3 good reps.

deposits.title: ROTATION + MOBILITY

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Cable Chop
exercises.cue: Rotate under control; keep pelvis steady.
exercises.prescription: 6 controlled half-kneeling cable chops/side; no trunk collapse.
exercises.home: 6 controlled half-kneeling cable chops/side; no trunk collapse.

exercises.name: Wall slides + open-book rotation
exercises.cue: Keep ribs relaxed and shoulders comfortable. Stop if painful.
exercises.prescription: Alternate gentle wall slides and side-lying open-book rotations. Split the allotted time equally; turn both ways without forcing range.
exercises.home: Alternate gentle wall slides and side-lying open-book rotations. Split the allotted time equally; turn both ways without forcing range.

martialSupplement.name: DUMMY LAB · ARM-DRAG CONNECTION
martialSupplement.home: Review a familiar arm-drag sequence slowly with the dummy, or study your trusted reference. Pause after the arm clears; inspect angle and connection. Up to 3 slow reps/side. Focus: Can I keep a useful connection after the drag without pulling harder?
martialSupplement.away: Visualize the same familiar positions and write one question.
martialSupplement.cue: Weekly question: can I keep posture and connection consistent while changing position?
martialSupplement.text: Optional 7 min slow technical study. Record one discovery. Not conditioning.
